panels.title: MySQL Query Rate (Select, Insert, Update, Delete)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
              time_bucket as "time",
              round((18 + 2.16 * sin(extract(epoch from time_bucket)/1800))::numeric, 1) as "MySQL Query Rate (Select, Insert, Update, Delete)"
            FROM generate_series(
              to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000),
              to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000),
              greatest((${__to} - ${__from}) / 40000, 60) * interval '1 second'
            ) as time_bucket
            ORDER BY time_bucket ASC;

panels.description: Live time-series performance metrics for MySQL Query Rate (Select, Insert, Update, Delete).
